generation.description: A branded illustration for a LinkedIn post. Text and frame are applied deterministically, so fixing the title does not require a new generation.
generation.subtitlePlaceholder: What you need to know before the rules take effect
generation.ideaPlaceholder: E.g. a bridge joining two banks as a metaphor for agreement
generation.formatFrozen: The new format will apply to the next generation — the current backgrounds have different proportions.

assist.undoHelp: Restores the text from before the last AI change.
assist.helpPolish: Improves the wording without changing the meaning or the topic.
assist.helpRephrase: Same meaning, different angle. Each further click proposes something other than the versions already shown.
assist.helpProposeSubtitle: Proposes a line based on the post title.
assist.helpProposeIdea: Invents an illustration idea from the title and subtitle. Each further click gives a new idea.

result.emptyDescription: Fill in the title and click Generate. The variants will already carry the brand frame.

history.title: This session's history
history.note: The history lives only in this browser tab — refreshing the page clears it.

templates.title: Brand templates
templates.description: Font, colours, logo and frame geometry. The preview renders with the same function as the finished graphic.
templates.contrastBody: Text-to-background contrast is {{ratio}}:1, below the WCAG AA threshold (4.5:1). The text may be unreadable.
templates.afterSaveHint: You can upload a custom font and logo once the template is saved.
templates.fontRegularHint: A TTF/OTF file. A font without the full set of Polish characters will be rejected.
templates.fontBoldHint: The bold face — used for the graphic title.
templates.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG — normalised to PNG with transparency.
